_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture — assembled from public Spreed source, not captured from a real server. Verify against real traffic in Task 2.3. Represents the long-poll response of GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v3/signaling/{token}. Per Spreed's SignalingController::pullMessages, ocs.data is a list of signaling messages; the LAST element is always a {type:'usersInRoom', data:[...]} snapshot of current participants. Earlier elements (if any) are queued {type:'message', data:'<stringified JSON>'} records (offer/answer/candidate/control). This fixture shows a pull response that bundles an incoming offer, its ICE candidate, and the final usersInRoom snapshot for a 2-participant call. Anonymized: real sessionIds (32-hex) -> 'SESSION_1'/'SESSION_2'; actorId -> 'alice'/'bob'; actorType='users'; room token -> 'tok-test-call'. No real IPs appear in this file (ICE IPs live in the SDP/candidate fixtures).
_spec_discrepancy: Spec 2026-07-19-nctalk-call-design.md §7 mandates GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/signaling/{token}, but the Spreed PHP backend hard-restricts signaling endpoints to v3 (Call API stays v4). The response body shape is identical at either version; the path version must be reconciled against a real server in Task 2.3.
